design.name: Keeper of Last Breaths
design.identity: Kirkian grief keeper who guards the boundary of death.
features: Choose comfort or witness. As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet falls to 0 Health but is not killed outright, spend one Vigil use to stabilize it. Comfort also grants temporary Health equal to your Instinct modifier (minimum one), which does not awaken it; witness lets it speak one sentence even while Unconscious.

As an Action expend one Channel Divinity use to restore Health equal to twice your Doctor level to a creature at 0 Health within 30 feet. It can then stand without spending movement. This does not return a dead creature to life.

Once per Long Rest as a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet would die from failed death saves, restore it to 1 Health instead and reset its death saves. This cannot prevent instant death from massive damage or disintegration.

features.name: Stay the Crossing
features.description: Choose comfort or witness. As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet falls to 0 Health but is not killed outright, spend one Vigil use to stabilize it. Comfort also grants temporary Health equal to your Instinct modifier (minimum one), which does not awaken it; witness lets it speak one sentence even while Unconscious.
features.completionRules: Stay the Crossing requires sight, resolves after reaching 0 but before later death saves, and temporary Health does not awaken its target. One More Dawn resolves before death from the third failed death save is finalized; it cannot reverse an already recorded death.
